create_SE3_tensor: create a random SE3 Lie tensor with a given batch size and requires_grad flag
create_SO3_identity: create an SO3 identity Lie tensor for a specified batch size
convert_tensor_to_lietensor: convert a raw PyTorch tensor into a LieTensor preserving gradient history via from_tensor
wrap_tensor_as_lietensor: wrap a tensor as a LieTensor sharing storage via as_lietensor or cast
compose_SE3_tensors: compose two SE3 Lie tensors using the compose method or multiplication operator
